name: Open Workplace Health Standard: Workplace Wellbeing Question Bank
kind: resource maintained under OWHS; not part of the normative OWHS specification
summary: A provenance-tracked catalogue of workplace well-being survey items drawn from the public commons. Item wording is taken from each item's primary source, and only where verified verbatim and licensed for redistribution. Topic groupings are editorial and are not the normative OWHS construct-domain codelist.
editorial_grouping_note: Topic groupings are an editorial convenience, grounded in widely used public frameworks (the HSE Management Standards for the work-design groups; ONS and OECD for wellbeing outcomes). They are not the OWHS construct-domain codelist, which is normative and changes only by RFC. They reproduce no prior document's selection or arrangement.

coverage_informed_by.title: What Works Centre for Wellbeing, Workplace Wellbeing Question Bank (July 2020)
coverage_informed_by.role: informs coverage (which topics from the commons to include), never arrangement

ons_leadin: ONS asks these with the lead-in: "Next I would like to ask you four questions about your feelings on aspects of your life. There are no right or wrong answers. For each of these questions I'd like you to give an answer on a scale of 0 to 10, where 0 is 'not at all' and 10 is 'completely'."

licences.item_wording: Held by each primary source under the licence recorded per item.

groups.name: Wellbeing and satisfaction
groups.scope: Outcome measures of how people rate their lives and their work overall (ONS personal well-being, satisfaction, positive affect).

groups.name: Health and functioning
groups.scope: Self-rated health, work-related ill health, and mental well-being state.

groups.name: Health behaviours
groups.scope: Health-related behaviours such as physical activity and diet.

groups.name: Job demands and intensity
groups.scope: Workload, pace, deadlines, emotional demand, unsocial or long hours, and physical load. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Demands domain.

groups.name: Control, autonomy and skill use
groups.scope: Discretion over work and the chance to learn and use skills. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Control domain.

groups.name: Support and relationships
groups.scope: Support from managers and colleagues, feedback, recognition and team working. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Support and Relationships domains.

groups.name: Fair treatment and conduct
groups.scope: Fair treatment and freedom from bullying and harassment. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Relationships domain.

groups.name: Role, purpose and recognition
groups.scope: Role clarity, meaning, contribution, direction and recognition. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Role domain.

groups.name: Job security and change
groups.scope: Security of the job, prospects, and how change is handled. Aligns to the HSE Management Standards Change domain.

groups.name: Working time and the work-home boundary
groups.scope: Scheduling, flexibility, recovery and detachment from work outside hours.

groups.name: Physical environment and resources
groups.scope: The adequacy of tools, equipment and facilities for the job.

groups.name: Financial security
groups.scope: Pay adequacy, financial security and resilience.

groups.name: Organisational health culture and policy
groups.scope: Whether the organisation acts on, signposts and normalises support for health and well-being.
